preconditions.expression: t == int(stdin.split()[0]) and t >= 1 and t <= 5000
preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 5000) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 2 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:2*t+1] if line.strip())
preconditions.description: For each test case, the first line contains two integers n and m (2 ≤ n, m ≤ 100) representing the dimensions of the binary table.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line) == m for line in stdin.splitlines()[2*t+1:2*t+1+n*m] if line.strip()) and all(all(c in '01' for c in line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[2*t+1:2*t+1+n*m] if line.strip())
preconditions.description: Each of the next n lines contains a binary string of length m, where each character is either '0' or '1'.

preconditions.expression: sum(int(n)*int(m) for n, m in (line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:2*t+1] if line.strip())) <= 20000
preconditions.description: The sum of n*m for all test cases does not exceed 20000.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout.splitlines()[i] == '0' * n for i in range(2*t+1, 2*t+1+n*m))
postconditions.description: After applying all operations, every cell in every test case's table must be '0'.

postconditions.expression: all(len(stdout.splitlines()[i+1:i+1+k]) == k for i, k in enumerate([int(line) for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:2*t+1] if line.strip()]) if k > 0)
postconditions.description: For each test case, if k > 0 operations are performed, exactly k lines follow describing the operations.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 6 for line in stdout.splitlines()[2*t+1:2*t+1+n*m] if line.strip())
postconditions.description: Each operation line contains exactly six integers representing the coordinates of three cells.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= n and 1 <= int(y) <= m for line in stdout.splitlines()[2*t+1:2*t+1+n*m] if line.strip() for x, y in [(line.split()[0], line.split()[1]), (line.split()[2], line.split()[3]), (line.split()[4], line.split()[5])])
postconditions.description: Each coordinate in an operation must be within the bounds of the table (1 ≤ x ≤ n, 1 ≤ y ≤ m).

postconditions.expression: all(set((int(x1), int(y1)), (int(x2), int(y2)), (int(x3), int(y3))) == 3 for line in stdout.splitlines()[2*t+1:2*t+1+n*m] if line.strip() for x1, y1, x2, y2, x3, y3 in [line.split()])
postconditions.description: The three cells in each operation must be distinct.

postconditions.expression: all(any(abs(int(x1)-int(x2)) <= 1 and abs(int(y1)-int(y2)) <= 1 for x1, y1, x2, y2 in [(line.split()[0], line.split()[1], line.split()[2], line.split()[3]), (line.split()[0], line.split()[1], line.split()[4], line.split()[5]), (line.split()[2], line.split()[3], line.split()[4], line.split()[5])]) for line in stdout.splitlines()[2*t+1:2*t+1+n*m] if line.strip())
postconditions.description: The three cells in each operation must belong to some 2×2 square in the table.

postconditions.expression: all(int(k) <= 3 * int(n) * int(m) for k, n, m in zip([int(line) for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:2*t+1] if line.strip()], [int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:2*t+1] if line.strip()], [int(line.split()[1]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:2*t+1] if line.strip()]))
postconditions.description: The number of operations k for each test case does not exceed 3nm.
